title: Owlcat... Jesus Christ. Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
subtitle: No sacred cows: a design autopsy

description: A long, profane design review of Rogue Trader: graphics, ships, wealth, levels, lore, systems, and every missing thought between them.
